title: Sound effects second pass
subtitle: Ten focused options based on your feedback: impact layers, shorter shield hits, earlier Fireball attacks, and natural thunder. Compare them with the current effects, then mark your choices.
notice: R01–R03 are complete impact mixes. R04–R10 are edited source sounds to judge before mixing. All previews are peak-matched to −6 dBFS; perceived loudness can still differ. This page has its own saved feedback, and the original review remains available. These auditions do not change game audio.
footer: Second listening pass · 10 candidates · 5 current references · Your first feedback is preserved. Production game audio is unchanged. Export this pass separately when ready.
